# polymarket-quant

Intro paragraph.

## Selection contract

<!-- Read by packages/research-enrich to judge whether a document belongs in this topic. English on purpose. -->

- **Purpose:** How to price, quote, execute, and size risk in prediction markets and betting exchanges, with Polymarket as the primary venue.
- **Core:** Prediction-market microstructure, CLOB and limit-order books, market making and stochastic control, execution and arbitrage, forecast calibration, mechanism design, informed and insider trading in prediction markets, LLM or agent forecasting systems built for prediction markets, and empirical venue results, including negative results.
- **Adjacent (keep):** Position sizing and portfolio-risk methods (Kelly, drawdown control, robust or distributionally robust portfolio optimization, backtest methodology, and overfitting). Sports and horse-race models and pari-mutuel pools, because they price betting-exchange markets. DeFi AMMs, MEV, and resolution oracles, because inventory and arbitrage transfer. Kalshi and Betfair as structure comparators. Equity, FX, and crypto microstructure, execution, stochastic control, and forecasting theory, as theory that carries over. Regulation, governance, antitrust and legal analysis of prediction markets and Polymarket, because they bound what a strategy may do.
- **Collected on purpose:** Polymarket and CLOB API docs, fee and rate-limit pages, SDK and contract READMEs (clob-client, py-clob-client, ctf-exchange, neg-risk adapter), and UMA Optimistic Oracle docs.
- **Out of scope:** Cross-chain routing and signature schemes; personality or time-travel papers; profit listicles; factor investing, ESG or sustainable investing, fund-performance league tables, and stock-picking or sector-rotation strategies with no carry-over rule.
